items.title: Everest Kanto's Egypt unit signs non-binding CNG MEGC study MoU with CARGAS
items.text: EKC Egypt SAE, a subsidiary of Everest Kanto Cylinder, signed a one-year framework agreement with Natural Gas Vehicles Company (CARGAS) to assess manufacturing Multi-Element Gas Containers and trailers for a CNG virtual pipeline system in Egypt, the Middle East and Africa. No financial consideration, committed orders or guaranteed value were disclosed, and definitive agreements would need further negotiation. For India-listed EKC it is an exploratory overseas CNG-storage step, not an Indian Type IV earnings driver yet.
